howToUse.text: Choose 'SEO Slug' for clean blog/page URLs, 'URL Encode' for query strings, or 'URL Decode' to unescape.

Use the Copy button to quickly grab the formatted URL or slug.

Strips accents and diacritics cleanly for universal URL safety

faqs.q: Why is an SEO-friendly slug important?
faqs.a: Clean, human-readable URLs improve user click-through rates and help search engine crawlers understand page content quickly.

faqs.q: What is the difference between URL encoding and slug generation?
faqs.a: URL encoding converts characters into percent-escaped codes (e.g. %20 for space), whereas a slug replaces spaces with hyphens and removes special characters entirely.
